title: W05 to W09 Scoped Notification Push Delivery Access Contract
purpose: Permit only the W05 notification delivery runtime to resolve a notification recipient's active Expo endpoints and conditionally clear a provider-invalid token, without transferring D1-03 entity ownership.

delegatedRuntime.purpose: Deliver W05-owned social notifications to authenticated recipients' currently active Expo installations.

authority.notificationRecipient: Derived only from the persisted W05 D1-02 social_notification_push_outbox and social_notifications records.
authority.endpointOwner: Must exactly equal the notification recipient user ID.

forbidden: returning tokens to W01, APP, H5, PC, analytics or logs

operations.trigger: Expo ticket or receipt reports DeviceNotRegistered
requiredPredicates: current push token SHA-256 equals the hash captured when the Expo ticket was issued
operations.concurrency: Read current token, compare its hash to the delivery snapshot, then UPDATE with the exact current token as a compare-and-set predicate. Never clear a rotated replacement token.
forbidden: clearing a token after an unrelated provider error

dataHandling.tokenPersistence: Never copy raw push tokens into D1-02, outbox rows, delivery rows, Workflow payloads/results, logs or errors.
dataHandling.tokenSnapshot: Persist only SHA-256 token hash in W05 D1-02 delivery record so stale receipts cannot clear a rotated token.
dataHandling.endpointAccess: D1-03 read/write remains limited to the two operations in this contract.

architecture.notificationOutbox: W05 D1-02, atomic with social_notifications insert.
architecture.workflow: Existing W05 Worker-owned durable Workflow resource; no new Worker or Queue.

evidenceRequired: W05 D1-02 NOTIFY-003 migration and atomic notification-to-outbox trigger validation
W05 endpoint lookup is owner-scoped and capped at 20 rows
W05 DeviceNotRegistered cleanup compares SHA-256 against the exact ticket token snapshot
Negative test proves a rotated token is not cleared by an older receipt
W05 D1-03 binding deploy source and live binding evidence
Android/iOS provider ticket and receipt acceptance
nonGoals: No W10 or AUTH-013 Queue reuse
No new public API for delivery
No cross-D1 transaction or foreign key
